review_scope: offline manual-root migration and runtime checker; G3/G4/G5 excluded

checks.command: Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath <two migrated D-drive JSON files>
checks.result: Both files match the approved SHA-256 values

runner_test_review.basis: Migration lookup is fixed by source mapping, original approved path/SHA claim remains intact, storage paths are exact absolute paths, reparse points are rejected, and original-byte SHA plus schema/cross-binding checks remain enforced. Added tests cover real migrated inputs, altered bytes, and an unapproved reference.

runtime_checker_review.basis: Frozen checker writes UTC+8 timestamps and creates its result with exclusive mode x; its invocation chain imports the probe and calls _runtime, which verifies source bindings and imports XSDB/pyserial without creating SDK sessions/clients, starting servers, opening serial ports, initializing PS, loading DDR, or programming targets.

runtime_evidence.limitations: This is runtime import and binding evidence only; no hardware operations were authorized or performed. A future POR-bound qualification receipt must bind the new canonical entry digest and undergo independent review.
